evidence.notes: InboundEmailHandler is a user Apex callback interface; local tests dispatch handleInboundEmail on the user implementation and return an InboundEmailResult DTO.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingInboundHandlerEvidenceTest { private class Handler implements Messaging.InboundEmailHandler { public Messaging.InboundEmailResult handleInboundEmail(Messaging.InboundEmail email, Messaging.InboundEnvelope envelope) { Messaging.InboundEmailResult result = new Messaging.InboundEmailResult(); result.success = true; result.message = email.subject + ' from ' + envelope.fromAddress; return result; } } @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.InboundEmail email = new Messaging.InboundEmail(); email.subject = 'Trail'; Messaging.InboundEnvelope envelope = new Messaging.InboundEnvelope(); envelope.fromAddress = 'sender@example.test'; Messaging.InboundEmailResult result = new Handler().handleInboundEmail(email, envelope); System.assertEquals(true, result.success); System.assertEquals('Trail from sender@example.test', result.message); } }
